headline: CMS INDUSLAW, SAM, TT&A, CAM act on Yulu Bikes $93 million Series C fundraise
sum: Yulu Bikes Private Limited has raised an aggregate amount of $93 million from a Series C fundraise through a combination of $63 million in equity led by GEF Capital Partners and $30 million in debt. CMS INDUSLAW advised Yulu Bikes on this…
detail: Yulu Bikes Private Limited has raised an aggregate amount of $93 million from a Series C fundraise through a combination of $63 million in equity led by GEF Capital Partners and $30 million in debt. CMS INDUSLAW advised Yulu Bikes on this fundraise. Shardul Amarchand Mangaldas & Co advised lead investor GEF Capital Partners on this fundraise. TT&A advised existing investor Bajaj Auto Limited in connection with the transaction.
